title: Declaration in Resume: Meaning, Format and Samples for Indian Job Seekers
seoTitle: Declaration in Resume: Meaning, Format & Samples
seoDescription: A resume declaration is a line confirming your details are true. When you need it in India, sample wording with place and date, and what false info costs.
excerpt: Where the declaration line is needed and where it just wastes space, copy-ready wording for freshers, professionals and government forms, and what UPSC and attestation forms say about false information.
